items.description: The crash rate on Android 12 devices is four percent in the beta, which currently blocks the release.
items.source_quote: The crash rate on Android 12 devices is at four percent in the beta, so right now that is a release blocker.

items.description: Omar will fix the Android crash and have the fix in the build by 2026-10-28.
items.source_quote: I'll take the Android crash and have a fix in the build by 2026-10-28.

items.description: The app release depends on the new login API being deployed to production, which has not happened yet.
items.source_quote: the new login API is not deployed to production yet. The app release cannot go out until that API is live.

items.description: App store review can take up to a week, so a late submission may miss the November 3 marketing date.
items.source_quote: The app store review can take up to a week, so if we submit late we may miss the marketing date on November 3.

items.description: The team assumes the design team will not change the onboarding screens again.
items.source_quote: We are assuming the design team won't change the onboarding screens again.

items.description: The dark-mode toggle is dropped from version 3.2 and moved to 3.3.
items.source_quote: we drop the dark-mode toggle from 3.2 and move it to 3.3.

items.description: Omar will make sure Sofia has the final test build by Thursday so she can finish regression.
items.source_quote: Omar, can you make sure Sofia has the build by Thursday?
